manual.garden_cloche.line2: {0}Garden Cloches are machines designed to hasten the growth of plants in a controlled, semi hydroponic environment.{1}
manual.garden_cloche.line3: It allows even agriculturally challenged engineers to grow plants quickly and automatically harvest their produce.{0}
manual.garden_cloche.line4: The device accepts power through the plugs on the top and sides, and fluid and items through the other ports.{0}
manual.garden_cloche.line5: When provided with power and water, the Garden Cloche will use the water to grow crops.{0}
manual.garden_cloche.line6: Providing fertilizers such as {0}Sulfur{1} or {2}Industrial Fertilizer{3} will boost the growth speed significantly. Only one fertilizer will be used at a time, and will stay dissolved in the water until it is finished.{4}
manual.garden_cloche.line7: Soil and seeds are placed in the middle; each seed requires the correct soil to grow on, with dirt being automatically tilled into farmland.{0}
manual.garden_cloche.line8: Produced items are stored in the slots on the right, and will be automatically output through the hatch at the front of the glass dome.
